what_worked: Clear thesis linking efficiency and momentum to actionable category recommendations with two distinct routes.
fix_next: Verify core statistics against the actual dataset—top-10 share, zero-revenue rate, and category totals appear materially wrong or unverifiable.
verdict: Coherent strategy story undermined by multiple unverifiable or incorrect headline statistics.
factual_error_detail: Slide 2: zero-revenue stated as 26% (actual 21.6%); top-10 revenue share stated as 61% (reference 49.6%); Slide 6: B2B 5x advantage doesn't match reference median multiples (~2.3x) or mean multiples (~8x).

evidence.insight: Slide 4-5 combine efficiency (rev/company) with momentum (12-mo share) to rank categories—goes beyond simple totals. Slide 6 adds cross-cutting playbook. However, using mean for 'efficiency' in a power-law market they themselves identified is internally contradictory.
evidence.narrative: Clear arc: market reality → category landscape → efficiency+momentum → shortlist → playbook → two routes → next steps. Coherent thesis throughout. Landing on slide 7-8 is purposeful.
evidence.framing: Audience ('new entrant') is stated but vague. No limitations slide despite 274 missing categories (37.7% of categorized data) and 288 missing audience_type. No mention of survivorship bias or dataset scope. Scope of 'all-time revenue' vs '30-day revenue' never clarified.
evidence.accuracy: Multiple headline stats don't match reference: 26% zero-revenue (should be 21.6%), 61% top-10 share (reference 49.6%), B2B 5x claim misaligned. Category revenue figures appear to use an unspecified 'all-time' field at ~10-25x the 30-day reference, making them unverifiable. Mean used for efficiency despite acknowledged power-law skew.
evidence.visual: Clean, consistent design with good hierarchy. Bar charts are well-labeled and readable. Color palette is restrained. Slide 5 shortlist layout is effective. However, only two actual data charts across 8 slides—mostly text cards. No scatter plots or distributions despite discussing skew.
evidence.ai_slop: Moderate consulting-template feel on slides 5-8 with numbered card layouts. 'The Efficiency Playbook' title and structure feel generic. However, content is specific enough to the dataset to avoid pure filler.
